questions.question: There is 70% increase in an amount in 7 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest on ₹8,000 after 3 years at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount increased by 70% in 7 years

For compound interest sum = Rs. 8000

Time = 3 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

C.I = [P(1 + R/100)T - 1]

Here, P = sum, T = time, R = rate

**Calculation:**

Let the amount be Rs. 100a

So, increased amount = 100a + 100a × 70%

⇒ 170a

So, interest = 170a - 100a = 70a

Now, Let the rate of the interest be R

70a = (100a × 7 × R)/100

⇒ 7aR = 70a

⇒ R = 10

So, rate = 10%

Now, C.I = 8000[(1 + 10/100)³ - 1]

⇒ 8000[(1 + 1/10)3 - 1]

⇒ 8000[(11/10)3 - 1]

⇒ 8000[(1331/1000) - 1]

⇒ 8000[(1331 - 1000)/1000]

⇒ 8000[331/1000]

⇒ 8 × 331 = 2648

**∴ The compound interest is Rs. 2648.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Simple interest is constant throughout the period.

So, 70% in 7 years = 10 % in 1 year

∴ R = 10% and T = 3 years

Let the sum be 10 units, So, Amount = 10 + 10/100 = 11

For three years , sum = 10³ = 1000

1000 units = Rs. 8000, therefore 1 unit = Rs. 8

And Amount = 11³ = 1331

Interest = 1331 - 1000 = 331

Interest = 331 × 8 = 2648.

∴ The compound interest is Rs. 2648.

questions.question: Working together, A, B and C can do a certain work in 10 days. A is 20% more efficient than B, and C is 50% less efficient than B. B alone can complete the same work in:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let B's efficiency be 100 units, therefore

⇒ A : B : C = 120 : 100 : 50

⇒ A + B + C = 270 units

Total work = 270 × 10 = 2700 units

Time taken by B = 2700/100 = 27

**∴ B can do the work in 27 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A, B, and C completed work in 10 days

A is 20% more efficient than B

C is 50% less efficient than B

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B be 100x

The efficiency of A = 100x + 100x × 20%

⇒ 100x + (100x × 20/100) = 120x

The efficiency of C = 100x - 100x × 50%

⇒ 100x - (100x × 50/100) = 50x

Total efficiency = 120x + 100x + 50x = 270x

Total work = 270x × 10 = 2700x

Now, B can do the work = 2700x/100x = 27 days

**∴ B alone can complete the same work in 27 days.**

questions.question: Somu has borrowed ₹10,000 from a money lender with simple interest at a rate of 7% half yearly. How much amount will he pay to the money lender after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 10000, Time = 3 years 

Rate of interest = 7% half-yearly

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here, P = Principle, T = time, R = rate

**Calculation:**

When interest is taken half yearly,

Actual rate of interest = 2 × rate of interest 

∴ R = 7 × 2 = 14%

Now, S.I = (10000 × 3 × 14)/100 = Rs. 4200

So, amount after 3 years = 10000 + 4200 = Rs. 14200

**∴ He will pay Rs. 14200 to the money lender after 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** The rate of 7% is already given for half a year and the period is given as 3 years. So, we need to convert either rate or time to any one format.

if we take time in years then the rate per year is 7 x 2 = 14 %

if we take time in a half-year format then time = 3 x 2 = 6

Hence, the solution and answer that we have given are correct.

questions.question: A boat can go 10 km upstream and 11 km downstream in a total time of 52 minutes, If the speed of the stream is 5 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total time taken by boat = 52 minutes

Distance travelled upstream = 10 km

Distance traveled downstream = 11 km

Speed of the stream = 5 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/speed

Upstream speed = u - v

Downstream speed = u + v

(a² - b²) = (a + b)(a - b)

Here, u = speed of the object

v = speed of the stream

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the boat be x km/h

According to the question,

(10)/(x-5)+(11)/(x+5)=(52)/(60)

⇒ (10)/(x-5)+(11)/(x+5)=(13)/(15)

⇒ (10x+50+11x-55)/((x-5)(x+5))=(13)/(15)

⇒ (21x-5)/((x²-25))=(13)/(15)

⇒ 315x - 75 = 13x² - 325

⇒ 13x2 - 325 + 75 - 315x = 0

⇒ 13x2 - 315x - 250 = 0

⇒ 13x2 - 325x + 10x - 250 = 0

⇒ 13x(x - 25) + 10(x - 25) = 0

⇒ (x - 25)(13x + 10) = 0

So, x = 25 or - (10/13)

As speed cannot be negative so x = 25

Speed of the boat = 25 km/h

So, downstream speed = 25 + 5 = 30 km/h

**∴ The speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Time taken to go upstream = 10/(u - v)

Time taken to go downstream = 11/(u + v)

⇒ 10/(u - v) + 11/(u + v) = 52/60

⇒ 10/(u - 5) + 11/(u + 5) = 52/60

Put the value of "u" from the option i.e.

Put u = 25 and equate the values

⇒ 10/20 + 11/30 = 52/60

⇒ (30 + 22)/60 = 52/60

⇒ 52/60 = 52/60

Hence the speed of the boat is 25 km/hr

Downstream speed = 25 + 5 = 30 km/hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**Downstream speed⇒ speed of the boat+speed of water

questions.question: In 2021, a cricket team wants to win 80% of the matches out of 225 matches. Out of 120 matches already played, the success rate is 70%. What should be the success rate for the remaining matches in order to reach the target?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total matches = 225

Target win % = 80

Success rate out of 120 matches = 70%

**Calculation:**

Total match to win = 80/100 × 225 = 180

Matches won out of 120 = 120 × 70/100 = 84

Matches remaining = 225 - 120 = 105

Required win remaining = 180 - 84 = 96 

∴ Team needs to win 96 matches out of 105

Required success rate = 96/105 × 100

⇒ 640/7 = 91(3)/(7)%

**∴ The required success rate is 91(3)/(7)%.**

questions.solution:

Loss = 12%

Profit = 8.5%

Difference in profit % and loss % = 164

**Formula used:**

**Calculation:**

⇒100x - (100 × 12/100) = 88x

Selling price of 2nd case = 100x + 100x × 8.5%

⇒ 100x + (100x × 8.5/100) = 108.5x

According to the question,

108.5x - 88x = 164

⇒ 20.5x = 164

⇒ x = (164/20.5)

⇒ x = 8

So, the cost price of the article = 100 × 8 = Rs. 800

**∴ The cost price of the article is ₹800.**

108% of CP - 88% of CP = 164

⇒ 108.5 units - 88 units = Rs. 164

⇒ 20.5 units = Rs. 164

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 8

∴ CP = 100 × 8 = Rs.800

Hence, The cost price of the article is ₹800.

questions.question: A takes 15 days to complete (5)/(7) of a work. With the help of B, they finish the whole work in 12 days. In how many days, B alone will complete the same work
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete 5/7 of work = 15 days

Time taken by both together to complete work = 12 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

A completes (5)/(7) of the work in 15 days

He will complete the total work in = 15 × (7/2) = 21 days

Let the efficiency of A be x

Total work = 21 × x = 21x

Now, A and B together complete the work in 12 days

So, the efficiency of (A + B) = 21x/12 = 1.75x

So, the efficiency of B = 1.75x - x = 0.75x

Now, the time taken by B to complete the task alone 

⇒ 21x/0.75x = 28 days

**∴ B alone will complete the same work in 28 days.**

questions.question: A trader marked the price of an article so as to earn a profit of 28% on its cost price. He sold it by giving 15% discount on its marked price. What was his actual profit percentage?

Profit% = (108.8 - 100)/100 × 100

⇒ Profit% = 8.8

**∴ Actual profit for trader is 8.8%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ 100a + 100a × 28% = Rs. 128a

He is giving a discount of 15%

So, actual profit = 108.8a - 100a = 8.8a

Profit% = (8.8a/100a) × 100 = 8.8%

**∴ His actual profit is 8.8%.**
